bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'SOURCE_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SOURCE_PATH='; pwd
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'RUNNING_GAYBBS='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '^deploy-gaybbs-1$' || true
printf 'POSTGRES='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(postgres|db)' | head -3 || true
printf 'ISSUE_SIGNALS='
docker logs --since '2026-11-11T14:40:00Z' --until '2026-11-11T15:15:00Z' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -E 'ROOM_RECONCILE_FAILED|POST_PUBLICATION_FAILED|POST_SENT_SOURCE_SYNC_NEEDS_RECONCILE|PUBLISH_NEEDS_RECONCILE' | sed -E 's/(owner|user|chat|source|message|room)[_A-Za-z]*[=:][^, }]+/\1=REDACTED/g' | tail -12 || true
